rationale: log/tab_ipw_mfg_byperiod.scsv (Table 2) reports the coefficients on future-period import exposure (d_tradeusc~e) in columns 4-6: 0.431 (SE 0.149) for 1970-1980, -0.130 (SE 0.126) for 1980-1990, and 0.148 (SE 0.095) for the stacked specification. These reproduce the paper's reported falsification-test values of 0.43, -0.13, and 0.15 essentially exactly (well within 5% relative error; the near-zero 1980-1990 value sits within a small absolute band of -0.13). The positive/insignificant future-exposure coefficients match the paper's conclusion of no reverse-causality pre-trend. The only fix in fix_severity.json was a trivial matplotlib install affecting plotting only, not this numerical result.
